description:
Create, list, show and delete person files at people/<Name>.md. People are the link targets for note attendees and task assignees. They are not threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files, open people only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Args:
  QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results ranked by similarity
  PERSON  full name, i.e. the filename without .md

Flags:
  list:
    --all          include closed people
    --json         JSON output
  show:
    --json         JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME    required; full name; becomes the filename; no '/', must not start with '.'
    --category C   required; professional|personal|voluntary
  delete:
    -y, --yes      required to confirm

Examples:
  ["list", "rivera"]
  ["show", "Sam Rivera", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Sam Rivera", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  `delete` is permanent. Without -y it refuses and exits 1.
  Exit 1 means one of: an empty or invalid name, the person already exists, the person is not found, or delete was run without -y.
